text:
Badger Elementary had 18 5th-graders take 2024-25 MCA science exam
L. O. Perez
Fifth-graders at Badger Elementary School were solely assessed in the science section of the 2024-25 MCA, according to the Minnesota Department of Education.
A total of 18 students participated in the science assessment at Badger Elementary, all of whom were in the fifth grade.
According to test standards, 28% of fifth-grade students were considered proficient in science.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are the statewide assessments that evaluate student achievement against Minnesota’s academic standards and fulfill legislative requirements at both the federal and state levels. These exams assess math, reading, and science, corresponding to the grade being tested. While most students take the MCA, those receiving special education services who meet required criteria may be given the Alt MCA instead.
Statewide MCA proficiency levels in Minnesota have dropped compared to pre-pandemic figures, based on Minnesota's Report Card. Since 2019, math proficiency has decreased by over 7%, and reading proficiency has declined by nearly 5%.
This article draws on Minnesota Department of Education data. Source data is available here.
